613.name: Five-Point Slash
613.skilldes:
Quickly conceal yourself in shadow, becoming unselectable and immune to abnormal effects and damage. Perform rapid consecutive strikes in the darkness, dealing 5 hits of <color=#ed9053>1500%</color> Adaptive DMG, then emerge and deal <color=#ed9053>2500%</color> Adaptive DMG. Each hit has <color=#ed9053>10%</color> chance to inflict Bleed (5 sec) and Darkness (2 sec). Targets killed within 3 sec of being hit cannot revive for 10 sec. This skill cannot be reflected. PVP skill multiplier reduced by 50%.
Adaptive DMG is determined by the highest of your current Damage Type Stats (PDMG Bonus%, MDMG Bonus%), Damage Range Type Stats (Melee PDMG%, Ranged PDMG%, Ranged MDMG%), and Element Type Stats (Neutral DMG%, Water DMG%, Earth DMG%, Fire DMG%, Wind DMG%, Poison DMG%, Holy DMG%, Shadow DMG%, Ghost DMG%, Undead DMG%). Damage type and bonus calculation are based on the highest Stat. Damage dealt ignores Element Advantage and Weapon Size Advantage, remaining at 100%.
